name: MyLLM Skills
description: Curated open Agent-Skill format skills for MyLLM (instruction-only).

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.description: Turn raw meeting notes or a transcript into clean minutes.

skills.name: commit-message
skills.description: Write a Conventional Commits message from a description of code changes.

skills.name: email-reply
skills.description: Draft a clear, professional email reply from a few bullet points and the desired tone.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review a code snippet for bugs, security issues, and style, with concrete fixes.

skills.name: flashcards
skills.description: Turn notes or a topic into a set of question/answer study flashcards.

skills.name: explain-simply
skills.description: Explain a complex topic in plain language with an everyday analogy.

skills.name: summarize-url
skills.description: Summarize a web page or article from a URL — TL;DR plus key points.

skills.name: research-brief
skills.description: Answer a question with a short, sourced research brief and citations.

skills.name: proofread
skills.description: Proofread and tighten text, fixing grammar, clarity and tone, and show what changed.

skills.name: sql-query
skills.description: Write a SQL query from a plain-English request and a table schema.

skills.name: regex-builder
skills.description: Build and explain a regular expression from a description, with examples.

skills.name: unit-tests
skills.description: Write unit tests for a function or module, covering edge and error cases.

skills.name: changelog
skills.description: Turn a list of commits or changes into a Keep a Changelog release.

skills.name: decision-matrix
skills.description: Weigh options against weighted criteria to support a decision.
